responsibility: This header declares the C interface for gm2’s auxiliary tree library. It provides prototypes for generic call builders, modify-expression construction, set and field address/value helpers, generic add_stmt/build_stmt wrappers, and bit-test jump helpers, supporting reuse of common GCC tree-manipulation patterns across the frontend.
same_name_distinction: C/C++ header for the m2treelib group: it declares the native helper routines such as DoCall* and set-access utilities, while m2treelib.def is the Modula-2 foreign-definition view and m2treelib.cc provides the executable support-library code.
